gloss_en: 'Mah' (מָה, "what") — the kabbalistic aspect/divine name Mah (Havayah spelled with alephs, gematria 45 = Adam), denoting self-nullification, humility, and Chokhmah ('koach mah'); the interrogative used as a mystical designation (Torah as 'mah ha-edot', wisdom as 'mah', man as 'mah'), not the plain interrogative pronoun
